messages:
sara.k: incident-bot just fired: high queue depth on runtime-autoscaler (inference-router-prod). PD page incoming. seeing sustained queue > 10k for 5m, 99th latency spiking.
incident-bot: ALERT: service=runtime-autoscaler env=prod metric=queue_depth value=10234 threshold=5000 duration=00:05:12 — PagerDuty incident created: PD-4521
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD-4521 triggered and routed to oncall-rotation. Escalation policy: realtime-oncall -> eng-sre -> eng-oncall.
benji: acked PD-4521. I’m hopping in. quick check: are we seeing consumer pods OOM or just slow scale?
sara.k: no OOMs in nodes, pods are healthy but backlog not draining. autoscaler logs show failed scale attempts due to rate limiter on provider side — 429s from cloud API.
hao: confirmed — cloud API quota spikes. There's a throttling window causing scale-ups to be rejected. I can try manual override to provision reserved nodes if we want immediate capacity.
benji: do it. we need to stop customer impact. anyone seeing errors bubble up to customers? alex in support?
sara.k: support reports elevated 504s on /v1/generate for a handful of enterprise tenants. Not wide but noticeable: approx 0.8% of requests failing with timeout. Logging sample from gateway: `backend error: no available instances to route`
benji: ok, mitigation plan: 1) temporarily re-route lower-priority traffic to canary region 2) manually scale a nodepool to add 8 GPUs in us-west-2 3) increase autoscaler retry/backoff config after we stabilize. I'm going to open a manual infra task.
hao: manual scale command (cloudctl):
```
cloudctl nodepool resize --region us-west-2 --pool runtime-gpu-prod --replicas 8 --type p4
```
benji: running that now. will watch cloud api responses.
incident-bot: Scale request submitted: request_id=rq_8f3b, status=pending.
sara.k: while that's provisioning, can we drop non-critical batch jobs that are filling queue? Suggestment: turn off nightly embedding reindexer for prod for next hour. @data-team?
benji: data-team is paged, but I'll ripple a quick kill: `kubectl scale deployment embeddings-reindexer --replicas=0 -n prod`
hao: done. confirmed reindexer pods terminating. queue inflow dropped ~30% in the last 60s. good.
benji: cloud API is accepting nodepool resize now — started creating instances. estimated ready in ~4m.
incident-bot: Node pool p4 provisioning: 2/8 ready (2 GPUs online).
sara.k: routing adjustment: i'm flipping the traffic-classifier to deprioritize free-tier traffic to the canary region. command: `curl -X POST https://console.cfg/route -d '{"policy":"deprioritize_free"}'` — applying.
benji: can we confirm any dataplane errors while the new nodes warm? tailing router logs: latency 95th dropping from 1.2s -> 0.7s for routed traffic. Still a small tail for high-length requests.
hao: nodepool now 8/8 ready. autoscaler still shows muted scaling because earlier 429s triggered a cooldown. we should reset autoscaler internal throttle to allow more rapid future scale-ups. 
sara.k: agreed. my plan: patch autoscaler config: set api_retry_max=8, backoff_base=2s, disable client-side cooldown for next 10m. Then revert after stability. applying patch now.
benji: patch applied. forcing a test scale-up to ensure config honored: `kubectl annotate deployment runtime-autoscaler force-scale=now -n prod`
incident-bot: Annotation observed. Autoscaler triggered scale event, new desired replicas=24 -> successful.
sara.k: queue depth trending down to 1.2k and still decreasing. 504s count dropping.
benji: good. PD-4521: adding postmortem label and assigning lead to @hao. Will keep incident open until metrics are back to baseline for 20m.
hao: taking lead on postmortem. immediate action items: (a) escalate provider support about API throttle (b) add secondary pipeline to request more conservative scale increments when API returns 429s (c) create emergency quota request with provider.
sara.k: I’ll follow up with support and customer success about impacted tenants. drafting message to affected customers with ETA.
benji: passing on-call to @oncall-rotation in 10m. if anything flares, re-ping PD. Otherwise we'll mark as mitigated and start RCA. thanks all. :thumbsup:
oncall-rotation: acknowledged handoff. monitoring dashboards and will watch for recurrence.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: PD-4521 acknowledged by benji. Escalation paused.
sara.k: final check: 95th latency back to normal, queue at 430 and steady. customer errors dropped to baseline. leaving notes and will attach logs to the incident. closing updates in 20m if stable.
benji: marking incident as mitigated in Slack thread. follow-ups: add autoscaler retry tuning to runbook, add guardrail to detect provider 429 surge and failover to reserve nodes earlier.
hao: noted. I'll start a PR for the autoscaler changes and link PD-4521.
sara.k: thanks everyone. closing channel updates, will post postmortem when ready. :white_check_mark:
